title: The /ops/wo row shows a demo action refused before any build (BRIEF_NOT_READY) and a pinned template as pinned
steps: Seed the ops-wo stand-in pool (apps/tracy-web/test/ops-wo.test.mjs) with an opportunity that has a brief revision and whose latest wo_demo_action is status=failed, error=BRIEF_NOT_READY, with no wo_build row for it.
Call GET /api/ops/wo as an admin seat and read that opportunity's row.

Repeat with a paused, failed, blocked and completed research job; with an older live wo_build requested before the refused action; with a completed action that owns that build; and read which ids the action query was scoped to.
expect: row.demoAction.status = failed, row.demoAction.error = BRIEF_NOT_READY, row.demoAction.hasBuild = false
row.needsAttention = true and row.queueState = BLOCKED; row.attentionReason and row.currentStep contain BRIEF_NOT_READY
row.templateSource = pinned and row.template = settings.pinnedTemplates[row.cms]; row.demoStatus = none
row.researchRollup = failure for a paused/failed/blocked research job, success for a completed one
with an older live build: needsAttention = true, queueState = BLOCKED, demoSite still the old site key; a completed action owning a done build leaves the row at stage 7-live, IDLE, no attention
the action query is scoped with where a.opportunity_id = any($1) to the loaded opportunity ids

selectors.fields: opportunities[].demoAction.status, opportunities[].demoAction.error, opportunities[].templateSource, opportunities[].needsAttention, opportunities[].queueState, opportunities[].researchRollup

evidence: Issue #552: Portland City Boxing on dev (develop f25af7cb7, 2026-11-10) showed Research Pass and template tracy-base/j6 after demo actions 9893fc3c, 039d28e2, 2690939d, addd37d0, a0e38dbe all failed with BRIEF_NOT_READY and no wo_build row existed.
fence: listWoQueue joins the latest wo_demo_action per loaded opportunity and turns a refusal without its own build, newer than the latest build, into attention; the template fallback is labelled pinned.

tests: GET /api/ops/wo: a demo action refused before any build shows its failure
GET /api/ops/wo: a refused demo action keeps the research rollup rule
GET /api/ops/wo: a demo action refused after an older live build still needs attention
GET /api/ops/wo reads demo actions only for the opportunities the list loaded
